description: POST /v2/droplets answers oneOf(Single, Multiple) keyed on whether the request carried `name` or `names`. The converter emits a type-level union for the oneOf but its runtime schema is S.Unknown, so the response is never decoded and consumers must narrow on the union before reaching the created id. Replace it with one object carrying both optional members so the response has a real struct schema — a single-create response populates `droplet`, a multi-create response populates `droplets`.
